data.name: Erfaan
data.gender_notes: Erfaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has extensive knowledge and is considered wise and learned in society. The name Erfaan carries the meaning “Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Erfaan usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is expected to grow up to be a wise and knowledgeable person, who will use his knowledge and wisdom to benefit others and bring peace and harmony to society.
data.etymology: Erfaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erfaan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عرفان
in_arabic.meaning: معرفة و آگاهی در دین و دنیا
in_arabic.long_meaning: عرفان به معنی معرفت و شناخت است، که شامل آگاهی از دین و دنیا می شود. این نام از ریشه عرف گرفته شده است که در قرآن کریم نیز به کار رفته است. عرفان به معنای فهم و درک عمیق از امورات زندگی و دین است.

in_urdu.name: عرفان
in_urdu.meaning: دین و دنیا میں سمجھ و آگاہی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عرفان کا مطلب ہے سمجھ و آگاہی، خاص طور پر دین و دنیا کے متعلق۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'عرف' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'سمجھنا' یا 'جاننا'۔ اسلامی روایت میں، عرفان کو معرفت اور روحانی سمجھ کے طور پر بیان کیا گیا ہے جو فرد کو زندگی کے مقاصد اور خدا کی مرضی کو سمجھنے میں مدد کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इरफ़ान
in_hindi.long_meaning: इरफ़ान का अर्थ है धार्मिक और सांसारिक ज्ञान। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'इरफ़' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है 'ज्ञान' या 'समझ'। मुस्लिम परंपरा में, इरफ़ान को आध्यात्मिक ज्ञान और समझ के रूप में वर्णित किया गया है जो व्यक्ति को जीवन के उद्देश्यों और ईश्वर की इच्छा को समझने में मदद करता है।

in_pashto.name: عرفان
in_pashto.long_meaning: عرفان د پوهې او پوهیدو معنی لري، په ځانګړي ډول د دين او دنياوي چارو په اړه. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'عرف' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د 'پوهیدل' يا 'معرفت' معنی لري. په اسلامي دود کې، عرفان د روحاني پوهې او سم ځي د يو فرد د ژوند د مقاصدو او د الله تعالی د ارادې د پوهیدو لپاره کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Erfaan
in_english.meaning: Knowledge and understanding in religion and worldly life
in_english.long_meaning: Erfaan is derived from the Arabic root 'arifa', meaning 'to know' or 'to understand'. In Islamic tradition, Erfaan signifies spiritual knowledge and understanding that enables an individual to comprehend life's purposes and divine will. It encompasses awareness of both religious and worldly matters, fostering a deeper connection with one's faith and the world.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Erfaan" carries a high level of respect and admiration within Islamic culture. It signifies a person who has acquired a vast amount of knowledge through extensive learning and experiences. Such individuals are often considered as scholars, teachers, or spiritual guides, playing important roles in shaping their communities and passing on the wisdom and values of their faith to future generations. At times, they are referred to as "Alim" or "Hafiz," which means scholar or one who has memorized the entire Quran. The title "Erfaan" further emphasizes their unique position in Islamic society, highlighting their intellectual, spiritual, and moral qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Erfaan" reflects an individual's deep connection to the divine and commitment to the pursuit of knowledge and self-improvement. The Islamic faith calls for lifelong learning and growing closer to God. Thus, the title "Erfaan" signifies a profound understanding of the teachings of the Quran and the Sunnah, as well as a commitment to applying these teachings to everyday life. Furthermore, it highlights the importance of knowledge and wisdom in the spiritual journey, emphasizing the idea that learning and seeking truth is a prerequisite for gaining closeness with the Divine. Overall, the name "Erfaan" represents a blend of intellectual and spiritual aspirations, reflecting the Islamic ideal of an intellectually and spiritually enlightened individual who continuously seeks knowledge, wisdom, and closer relationship with the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Erfaan: Wisdom from the heart's knowledge, a seeker of truth in the path of divine guidance.
